ColliderIntersected(Collision)

Called when a collider on this CollisionObject reports a collision. AdvancedCollisionNotifications have to be enabled on the collider! ComputeIntersection has to be enabled on the collider! ReportColliderCollision has to be enabled

ColliderOverlapped(Collider, Collider, bool)

Called when a collider on this CollisionObject reports an overlap. AdvancedCollisionNotifications have to be enabled on the collider! ComputeIntersection has to be disabled on the collider! ReportColliderCollision has to be enabled
